standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the p-th Chern class of the pulled back complex with the restriction of the Chern class of the object along the morphism, which is the last step of the proof.

core_obligations: Choose the trivialising envelope and base change it: take an envelope over which the object is represented by a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules, and base change it along the given morphism, which stays an envelope (proof lines 9374-9379).

Build the integral proper birational model: choose a point of the base change mapping to the generic point of the given integral scheme with the same residue field, take the integral closed subscheme through it, and note that the restriction of the projection to it is a proper birational morphism (proof lines 9379-9384).

Conclude: the pullback of the representing complex to that integral model is a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules, hence bounded with terms of constant rank, it represents the pulled back object, and its p-th Chern class is the restriction of the Chern class of the object (proof lines 9385-9390).
proof_roadmap: Trivialising envelope and its base change (proof lines 9374-9379).
Integral proper birational model through a point over the generic point (proof lines 9379-9384).
Pull back the complex and read off the restriction identity (proof lines 9385-9390).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a perfect object whose Chern classes are defined, any locally finite type morphism from an integral scheme can be replaced by an integral proper birational model on which the pulled back object is represented by a bounded complex of locally free modules of constant rank, with the p-th Chern class of that complex equal to the restriction of the Chern class of the object (statement lines 9355-9372, tag 0GUE-adjacent). The proof base changes the trivialising envelope, chooses a suitable point over the generic point, cuts out an integral closed subscheme through it so that the projection becomes proper and birational, and pulls back the representing complex, using integrality to conclude boundedness and constant rank. The construction of the model is the substance, so the claim is H2.
